posts.text:
I WALK AROUND LIKE EVERYTHING IS FINE. BUT DEEP DOWN, INSIDE MY SHOE, MY SOCK IS SLIDING OFF.

Everybody's got a sock situation. Keep walking.

Save this one for the hard days.

#WeTheHumans #StayAwesomeHumans #FunnyQuotes
posts.alt: Quote card: I walk around like everything is fine. But deep down, inside my shoe, my sock is sliding off.

posts.text:
IT'S OK. YOU JUST FORGOT WHO YOU ARE. WELCOME BACK.

You're still in there. Always were.

Tag a human who lives this.

#WeTheHumans #StayAwesomeHumans #BeHuman
posts.alt: Quote card: It's ok. You just forgot who you are. Welcome back.

posts.text:
BLESSED ARE THE CURIOUS. THEY GET THE ADVENTURES.

Curiosity is a ticket. Use it.

Somebody you know needs this one today.

#WeTheHumans #StayAwesomeHumans #BeHuman
posts.alt: Quote card: Blessed are the curious. They get the adventures.

posts.text:
EVERY MORNING, TWO CHOICES: SLEEP WITH YOUR DREAMS, OR WAKE UP AND CHASE THEM.

The alarm clock is a fork in the road.

Who needed this one today?

#WeTheHumans #StayAwesomeHumans #Motivation
posts.alt: Quote card: Every morning, two choices: sleep with your dreams, or wake up and chase them.

posts.text:
TOO BUSY WORKING ON MY OWN GRASS TO NOTICE IF YOURS IS GREENER.

Water your own yard.

Send this to your favorite human.

#WeTheHumans #StayAwesomeHumans #FunnyQuotes
posts.alt: Quote card: Too busy working on my own grass to notice if yours is greener.

posts.text:

Save this one for the hard days.

#WeTheHumans #StayAwesomeHumans #KeepGoing
posts.alt: Quote card: Haters. Doubters. Non-believers. Then there's you, proving them wrong.

posts.text:
ONE DAY, OR DAY ONE. YOU DECIDE.

Today counts if you say it does.

Tag a human who lives this.

#WeTheHumans #StayAwesomeHumans #Motivation
posts.alt: Quote card: One day, or day one. You decide.
